newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. 1,221 MW nuke seen at full power on weekend.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. 1,221 MW nuke seen at full power on weekend.

text.p: The 1,221 megawatt (MW) Palo Verde nuclear power unit 3 was expected to reach full power over the weekend following a shutdown for refueling and maintenance, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
The unit, located in Wintersburg, Ariz., was operating at 68 percent of capacity as of early Friday and was holding power for restart testing, the spokesman said.
Palo Verde 3 was shut for planned refueling in February, and resumed operations last weekend.
The two adjacent Palo Verde units, each also with a capacity of 1,221 MW, were producing at full output.
